summary: Bonner County lookout on the Kaniksu National Forest: a 10-foot L-4 tower built in 1932 was destroyed in 1941. Its alidade table and a carved inscription remain on the summit.

facts.design: L-4 cab on a 10-foot pole tower
facts.status_note: The tower was destroyed in 1941. The alidade table and a carved inscription remain on the summit.

notes_for_editor: Construction (1932) and destruction (1941) agree across three sites. The Painter and Stobie staffing rests on the Idaho writers' own identification, and the Painter link is stated as a belief, not a record. Record height_m 3.05 is the sourced 10 feet converted to metres. Access is left out of facts: sources call it hike-in and describe visits, but none states current public access or closures, so the story says so. A Facebook post by the Idaho writers (not read) and the Priest Lake Museum photo captions (search snippets only) were not cited.
